scope: Public monthly regional research-return benchmarks; acquisition only, not individual-stock point-in-time data or FREM evidence
selection: Geographical three-factor families and US reference, chosen before download; do not select by returns
units: Original percentages divided by 100; market_total = market_excess + rf; research portfolios, not prices
limitations: Current-vintage data can be revised; historical publication availability is not established.
Regions overlap and are not independent replications.
Aggregated research portfolios do not supply individual-stock membership, execution prices, actions or default records.
Public access does not establish redistribution rights; raw and derived downloads remain local.
Only dates before 2025-01 are numerically parsed; raw archives can contain later observations and must remain opaque.
No new hypothesis, fit, protected evaluation or positive performance claim is created by acquisition.
